## 2026-07-18 - GitHub Actions Supply Chain and Privilege Escalation Hardening
**Vulnerability:** Default permissive GHA permissions and unpinned, mutable action references (`@v4`, `@v5`) expose the runner and repository to supply chain attacks and token theft in the event of an upstream dependency compromise or malicious branch execution.
**Learning:** Standard templates generated by framework CLI tools lack strict security-by-default options, defaulting to mutable tags and broad implicit permissions. In uninitialized repositories, this is further exacerbated by build workflows running blindly without manifest files, creating noisy CI runs.
**Prevention:** Always pin third-party actions to immutable 40-character commit SHAs, enforce global/job-level `permissions: contents: read`, configure strict timeouts, and add step-level guards to bypass build steps in uninitialized repository states.
